market_summary: Bullish super cycle. 7-8% pullback framed as 'a gift' — wall of worry. Guest Matthew Caruso: 'This would be the first time people called a bubble in real time and were right.' Deploy capital in tranches at support levels. Core positions for 6-9 months.
notable_quotes: This is a gift — Matthew Caruso
This would be the first time people would be bearish at a top and call a bubble in real time — Matthew Caruso
